deterministicTests: test -f input.csv && test -f expected.csv && test -x "$(command -v vim)" && test "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = /app
acceptanceCriteria: The unchanged external Harbor verifier passes and input.csv matches the generated expected.csv after the macro script runs.
apply_macros.vim contains the requested non-empty macros and is the only task output modified by the agent.
riskNotes: This is a local workspace-compatible derivative of terminal-bench@2.0; only environment/Dockerfile adds Git and commits generated task inputs as the clean baseline.
The deterministic command is a public input/tool/Git-root invariant and is not a substitute for the external verifier.
The task instruction and visible tests require headless Vim; no hidden verifier output is used as agent feedback.
allowLocalCommit is false; commits, pushes, merges, deploys, and external mutation remain forbidden.

sourceProvenance.sourceRevision: terminal-bench@2.0 (local extracted source; upstream commit not present)
sourceProvenance.canonicalDigestRule: sorted relative path + TAB + file SHA-256 + LF over all files
